origin.description: Separable nonlinear least squares. The nonlinear parameters go through Levenberg-Marquardt.
origin.usage: lsqsep(flist, p0, xdata, ydata, const = TRUE)

arguments.name: const
arguments.text: Include a constant column when true.

origin.details: One exponential plus a constant, started at -0.4, on 12 points of 1 + 2 exp(-0.5 x).
origin.value: Separable nonlinear least squares. The nonlinear parameters go through Levenberg-Marquardt.
origin.example: local({x<-seq(0, 2, length.out=12); y<-1+2*exp(-0.5*x); with(lsqsep(list(function(b, x) exp(b*x)), -0.4, x, y), c(a0, a, b, ssq))})
